# Actual compiler output for the SDK Memory slice

`compiler-memory-manifest.json` is generated by
`TestExportWorkerSDKMemoryFixture` in Control's deployment domain. It is not
hand-authored Manifest content. The source test canonicalizes the Agent/Profile
through their owner publication validators, calls the actual Compile function,
and verifies the resulting content and complete envelope.

Run `scripts/test-worker-manifest-sdk.sh` from this repository to regenerate into
an independent temporary directory, compare the frozen fixture byte-for-byte,
and run the actual SDK LLMAgent -> memory_add -> memory_load -> Final flow.
The helper performs no live provider or backend calls.

The fixture uses a single assistant, Memory tools memory_add/memory_load and
preload_limit=0, legacy PostgreSQL Session and managed Redis Memory descriptors.
The static platform-v1 contract is explicitly test-only; the production Worker
V1 gate still rejects it. Synthetic credential references contain no secrets.
The Worker test uses a deterministic Model and attempt-private Memory service,
not the physical Redis described in the fixed snapshot. Its resulting candidate
is not an accepted Attempt or a durable Memory revision.
